blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two former bodyguards of ex-Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co, known as the “maleta boys,” are set to testify on Monday in the bail hearing of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez, who is facing a plunder case over alleged kickbacks worth P7.44 billion. George Villalon Jr. and Johnny Buduan will take the witness stand, their lawyer Levito Baligod told reporters on the sidelines of the hearing at the Sandiganbayan Third Division. Villalon and Buduan were among Co’s former bodyguards who allegedly helped deliver kickbacks to Romualdez, according to allegations in the plunder case.
